entry.name: Arquero de camello
entry.prompt: Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game: a desert mounted archer riding a tall one-humped dromedary camel, seated upright in a saddle on the hump, cream turban, a steel lamellar vest over a long cream robe, a turquoise cloak and sash, a recurved bow held upright in one hand, a tasselled turquoise saddle cloth, the camel's long curved neck raised. Standing square on all four straight legs, feet apart and flat on the ground, tail hanging clear of the legs, head up. Stylized painted realism, chunky shapes, hard edges, flat faces. One solid model, isolated, no ground, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Camel coat warm fawn (#B8966A). Robes and turban cream (#E3D8BE). Lamellar vest steel grey (#8A8C8E) with bronze edging (#B07A3A). Cloak, sash and saddle cloth saturated turquoise (#1E8C8C). Leather and bow dark brown (#4A3526). No text or logos.
